description: Every data size (or the sizes asked for) for one coverage choice in one call, each with the server price and its own buy_url; with compare_continents also the whole world against each single continent — to show what a smaller coverage saves. Same server prices as quote_esim.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

compare_continents.description: Optional: also price the whole world and each continent alone.

continents.description: Continents to cover: eu (Europe), as (Asia & Middle East), am (Americas), af (Africa), oc (Oceania). Omit = the whole world (all five). Fewer continents can lower the price. A country is not a continent — use check_country or recommend_config for countries.

gb.description: Optional: the sizes to price. Omit = every size (3, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100).

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country and continent names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

name: price_grid
title: Price grid
